name: tikiapi
description: Images and video through TikiAPI: generation with live prices, consistent characters, ad videos from script to cut, ad scripts, audience tests and colour looks.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images and video, and make ads end to end
interface.longDescription: TikiAPI skills turn Codex into a small video studio. Generate images and clips with Seedance, Nano Banana, GPT Image and Seedream at live prices, keep a person consistent across shots, write and test ad scripts on simulated viewers, make a full vertical ad from script to finished cut, and match a colour look. Calls the TikiAPI MCP server or REST API with the key from TIKIAPI_KEY, prices every video before ordering it, and returns links.
defaultPrompt: Make a 9:16 product photo of this bottle with TikiAPI
Write a 30-second ad script for my app and test it on the audience room
Make a vertical ad video for my product, script to final cut
Create a character I can reuse in every shot
Match the colour look of this film still in a Seedance clip
